ui.title: Jodu Home Survey
ui.introP1: Jodu helps families and engineers in India plan their house, from the first conversation to the drawings.
ui.introP2: Whether you've already built, are building now or are still planning, we want to hear how you think about your house. There are no right answers.
ui.introAnon: Anonymous. Optional at the end: get a free 3D preview of your plot.
ui.givebackTitle: That's it! Your answers are anonymous.
ui.givebackP: If you'd like something back from us, leave your details.

ui.needContact: Add a phone number or email so we can reach you.
